coverage.basis: First online publication for articles. Issue month for covers.
coverage.review: The full candidate list was screened by title and scope. Visual review prioritized distinct ways of showing population studies, environmental and life-course exposures, cohorts and omics. Selected article figures and issue covers were reviewed separately. Unselected records remain in the annual scan.
